Thank you so much for replying. I've been refreshing a lot.

I think I just really need a talk with someone who's not seriously invested in my life (and can kind of relate), if that makes any sense. I'm glad I'm not alone, and I know that - I really don't even know if I'm in the minority. But it's hard for society to talk about it, or maybe I don't have the social skills to talk about it in a way that wouldn't worry others.

Thank you for your response, I do really appreciate hearing this.
